newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Cyclone expected to hit Bangladesh soon.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone expected to hit Bangladesh soon.

text.p: The core of a cyclone from the Bay of Bengal was just 80 km (50 miles) from Cox's Bazar at 10 a.m. (0400 GMT) and might reach land in the next two hours, an official said on Tuesday.

"It's definite the high velocity cyclone will hit us soon," said Ali Imam Majumder, the deputy commissioner of Cox's Bazar. "The maximum windspeed will be 200 kmh (112 mph) or more. Vast coastal areas may be inundated by a five metre (15 foot) sea surge," he told Reuters.
